CREATIVE ARTS — GENERAL ASSESSMENT #1
====

GRADE: Grade 4
SUBJECT: CREATIVE ARTS
TIME ALLOWED: 45 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 30
EXAM BODY: KPSEA

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. Primary colours are: (1 mark)
   A. Green, orange, and purple
   B. Black, white, and grey
   C. Brown, pink, and gold
   D. Red, blue, and yellow

2. In music, tempo refers to: (1 mark)
   A. The ticket price
   B. Only the volume
   C. The speed of the music
   D. Only the costume

3. Warming up before sport helps to: (1 mark)
   A. Replace drinking water
   B. Prepare muscles and reduce injury risk
   C. Guarantee a trophy
   D. Remove the need for rules

4. Best practice when working on Netball: (1 mark)
   A. Refuse all feedback on Netball.
   B. Disrupt classmates during Netball.
   C. Damage equipment used for Netball.
   D. Practise Netball with discipline, creativity, and respect for others.

5. Best practice when working on Painting and Montage: (1 mark)
   A. Practise Painting and Montage with discipline, creativity, and respect for others.
   B. Damage equipment used for Painting and Montage.
   C. Disrupt classmates during Painting and Montage.
   D. Refuse all feedback on Painting and Montage.

6. Best practice when working on Songs: (1 mark)
   A. Disrupt classmates during Songs.
   B. Refuse all feedback on Songs.
   C. Damage equipment used for Songs.
   D. Practise Songs with discipline, creativity, and respect for others.

7. Best practice when working on Melody: (1 mark)
   A. Refuse all feedback on Melody.
   B. Damage equipment used for Melody.
   C. Disrupt classmates during Melody.
   D. Practise Melody with discipline, creativity, and respect for others.

8. Best practice when working on Percussion Musical Instruments: (1 mark)
   A. Disrupt classmates during Percussion Musical Instruments.
   B. Practise Percussion Musical Instruments with discipline, creativity, and respect for others.
   C. Refuse all feedback on Percussion Musical Instruments.
   D. Damage equipment used for Percussion Musical Instruments.

9. Best practice when working on Swimming: (1 mark)
   A. Damage equipment used for Swimming.
   B. Practise Swimming with discipline, creativity, and respect for others.
   C. Disrupt classmates during Swimming.
   D. Refuse all feedback on Swimming.

10. Best practice when working on Rhythm: (1 mark)
   A. Practise Rhythm with discipline, creativity, and respect for others.
   B. Disrupt classmates during Rhythm.
   C. Refuse all feedback on Rhythm.
   D. Damage equipment used for Rhythm.

11. Best practice when working on Indigenous Kenyan Games: (1 mark)
   A. Damage equipment used for Indigenous Kenyan Games.
   B. Refuse all feedback on Indigenous Kenyan Games.
   C. Practise Indigenous Kenyan Games with discipline, creativity, and respect for others.
   D. Disrupt classmates during Indigenous Kenyan Games.

12. Best practice when working on Gymnastics: (1 mark)
   A. Refuse all feedback on Gymnastics.
   B. Damage equipment used for Gymnastics.
   C. Disrupt classmates during Gymnastics.
   D. Practise Gymnastics with discipline, creativity, and respect for others.

SECTION B — STRUCTURED / SHORT ANSWERS
----
13. In three clear sentences, explain Athletics and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

14. In three clear sentences, explain Gymnastics and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

15. In three clear sentences, explain Songs and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

16. In three clear sentences, explain Photography and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)
